cases.description: The buyer asks for a person: handed off with reason asked_for_human
cases.source: real: Gemma run 2026-11-16 promised a transfer but never called handoff_to_human
messages: I want to speak to a real person, not a bot.

cases.description: Asking for a discount is a negotiation: handed off
messages: 2 bed to rent in Dubai Marina, up to 120k a year.
Can you get me 10% off the rent on that one?

cases.description: Offering a lower purchase price is a negotiation: handed off
messages: I like the 2 bed for sale in JVC. Would the owner accept 1 million?

cases.description: A complaint is handed off with reason complaint
messages: Your agent didn't show up for my viewing yesterday. This is unacceptable.

cases.description: Arabic request for a human agent: handed off, reply in Arabic
messages: أريد التحدث مع وكيل عقاري حقيقي من فضلك

cases.description: Asking what something costs is not a negotiation: no handoff
messages: How much is the 2 bed for sale in JVC?

cases.description: A general question about an area is answered, not handed off
messages: What's Dubai Hills like for families? We might buy there next year.

cases.description: An unhappy-but-normal request ('anything cheaper?') is handled by searching again, not handed off
messages: 1 bed to rent in Downtown, up to 130k.
That's too expensive for me. Anything cheaper nearby?
